description: This is a test file for the CandidateMarkingInterviewFailAPI class, which contains unit tests for API endpoints related to marking an interview as failed in the recruitment module of OrangeHRM. The file includes setup routines, various test methods for 'getOne', 'getValidationRuleForGetOne', 'update', 'delete', and 'getValidationRuleForDelete', and uses mock services and data providers.
